class.name: InputEventJoypadTouchpad
class.brief_description: Represents a finger on a joypad's touchpad.
class.description: Sent when a finger touches, moves on, or leaves a joypad's touchpad, such as the one on a DualShock 4 or DualSense. Poll the same state with [method Input.get_joy_touchpad_finger_position].

members.member: Which finger this is, counting from [code]0[/code].
Where the finger is, from [code](0, 0)[/code] at the top left to [code](1, 1)[/code] at the bottom right.
[code]true[/code] while the finger touches the touchpad; [code]false[/code] in the event sent when it lifts.
How hard the finger presses, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
How far the finger moved since the previous event for it, in the same units as [member position].
Which touchpad the finger is on, counting from [code]0[/code].
